Full summary: Ran a 10-agent ultracode comparison of zilliztech/memsearch vs Twining (6 readers, 1 synthesis, 3 adversarial verifiers; ~976k tokens). Verdict: complementary tools — memsearch wins retrieval/capture, Twining wins decisions/coordination. Several verified findings are actionable for Twining.
Decisions: Chose to run the memsearch comparison as a workflow with adversarial verification (memsearch-accuracy, twining-accuracy, fairness lenses) over a single-context read — the verify pass caught 8 wrong/overstated claims in the synthesis, including two that would have flattered Twining (inert-graph premise, 'guarantees capture' framing)
Findings: Retrieval confirmed as Twining's weakest subsystem by independent code read: no BM25/TF-IDF anywhere, keyword fallback is substring includes() with log-TF and x0.5 discount (src/embeddings/search.ts:212-249), semantic channel capped at 10 candidates per store (search.ts:41,122), MiniLM-384 vs memsearch's benchmarked bge-m3 ONNX int8 (en R@5 0.814 vs OpenAI 0.767). memsearch's hybrid dense+BM25+RRF(k=60) fused in-store is the reference design.; warning: Gate 2 commit gate is satisfiable by ANY twining_post — the .last-record sentinel is written by twining_post (blackboard-tools.ts:68) and twining_decide (decision-tools.ts:105) as well as twining_record (record-tools.ts:470). A single unstructured post passes the gate with no decision recorded; weakens the 'gated structured capture' guarantee.; Correction to a belief stated in review context: graph_reachability (largest assemble weight, 0.35) is NOT usually inert — decision-side graph population is unconditionally on (src/server.ts:114-118); only blackboard-side extraction is behind graph.auto_populate. This repo's records/graph/entities has hundreds of records.; Records-tree git merges are conflict-free only for distinct new ULIDs — mutations rewrite the same file in place and removals unlink (src/storage/sync/record-export.ts:20-21), so two branches mutating the same record (e.g. both superseding one decision) can still conflict. The 'append-only immutable event records' framing is wrong.; Doc drift: src/config.ts:90 comment says full_surface:false hides '16 rarely-used tools' but 23 of 36 are actually hidden (13 exposed).; memsearch design ideas worth evaluating for Twining: (1) L1→L2→L3 progressive recall (chunk search → section expand → verbatim transcript) run in a forked subagent so intermediate results never pollute main context; (2) transcript anchors for verbatim provenance — Twining has no episodic/session-narrative layer at all; (3) embedding choice backed by a published benchmark.; Positioning fact the docs never state crisply: memsearch's own docs tell users to gitignore .memsearch/ (personal developer logs; team decisions belong in CLAUDE.md) — memsearch is per-developer memory, Twining is committed team coordination state. This is Twining's clearest structural differentiator alongside structured decisions.; memsearch has an open security issue (#594): config trust-boundary — malicious project-local .memsearch.toml can redirect embedding base_url to exfiltrate API keys during auto-index at session start. Relevant if anyone proposes running both tools side by side. Twining's own unexamined surfaces per the fairness critic: dashboard on port 24282 (auth/binding), shell hooks executing on every commit/stop.
